🎬 Nurses (2020–2021)

Nurses follows five young nurses working on the front lines of St. Mary’s Hospital, a busy medical center in downtown Toronto, as they dedicate their lives to saving others while struggling to manage their own personal challenges. Grace Knight, Ashley Collins, Keon Colby, Nazneen Khan, and Wolf Burke enter the demanding world of healthcare, where every shift brings unexpected emergencies, difficult decisions, and emotional encounters with patients and their families. From life-threatening medical situations and heartbreaking losses to complicated relationships and personal struggles, the nurses must learn to balance their professional responsibilities with their own emotional well-being. As they face intense pressure from doctors, hospital administrators, and the realities of modern healthcare, friendships are tested, secrets emerge, and their commitment to helping others is pushed to its limits. Combining powerful medical drama, emotional storytelling, and relatable personal experiences, the series explores compassion, sacrifice, friendship, resilience, and the extraordinary challenges faced by those who dedicate their lives to caring for others.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 43–44 minutes per episode • TV-PG

📺 Seasons: 2 Seasons • 20 Episodes

🎥 Creator: Adam Pettle

📺 Where to Watch: Available on Tubi for free with ads, and through select Amazon Prime Video channels. Also available for digital purchase on Apple TV, Amazon Video, and Fandango at Home. Availability varies by region.
